name: has-unit-per-file-read-transaction
body: `has_unit` opens one read transaction per call, and the full-load fallback's reuse-candidate admission calls it once per unchanged file on every incremental scan. The per-file probe is correct but linear in read-transaction overhead; if a large-tree rescan's time budget regresses, add a single-read-transaction batched probe alongside it in `cache::FactStore` and use it from the admission.
